summary: First iteration full e2e of Vaulta. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (auth, dashboard, transactions CRUD, income/expenses summary, royalties, publishing, contracts, invoices, budgets, taxes, business, funding, reports, vault, ecosystem, AIAH SSE stream). Frontend: quick-login-artist works, all 15 sidebar routes navigate cleanly, all 7 KPI cards render, invoice creation modal creates & lists new invoice (TEST_UI_Client visible), AIAH streams Claude Sonnet 4.5 response via suggested prompts (2514 char response received), logout returns to /login.

minor.issue: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Fine now because frontend and backend share the same emergent proxy origin, but if the app is ever accessed from a different origin the withCredentials:true cookie flow will silently break. Recommend explicit origins + allow_credentials=True.
set_cookie uses secure=False. Works over the proxy today but should be secure=True samesite='none' for cross-site production usage.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testids differ from the review-request spec. Actual: invoice-client-name, invoice-client-email, invoice-amount, invoice-due-date. Spec asked for invoice-*-input suffix. Not blocking functionality; tests were adapted, but consider aligning testids.

Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' printed on load. Chart still renders but the ResponsiveContainer is briefly initialised with 0 height. Consider giving container an explicit min-height.

action_items: Optional: align invoice modal data-testids to the 'invoice-*-input' naming used in the review request (invoice-client-input, invoice-amount-input, invoice-due-input).
Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer 0-size warning on Dashboard.
Optional: tighten CORS (explicit origin + allow_credentials=True) and cookies (secure=True, samesite='none') for cross-site production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 733 lines with all routes inline. Consider splitting per-resource routers for maintainability once beyond MVP.
owner_id_for() silently rewrites reads to the Artist's data for every non-Artist role. This is fine for demo showcase but must not ship to production without a permission model.
Business/Ecosystem endpoints return hardcoded static data — flagged for information; expected in MVP demo.
test_credentials: artist@vaulta.io / Vaulta2026! (used for all tests). Admin: admin@vaulta.io / Vaulta2026!
seed_data_creation: None manually; server seeds admin + demo users + full artist financial dataset on startup. A few TEST_ prefixed items (invoices, budgets, transactions, users) were created during tests; transactions test is self-cleaning, others left intentionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Frontend Playwright covered login, all 15 sidebar routes, invoice creation, AIAH streaming, logout. Invoice modal testids are invoice-client-name / invoice-amount / invoice-due-date (NOT invoice-*-input as originally spec'd). AIAH SSE endpoint /api/aiah/chat streams delta events successfully with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
